children: Symphony shares surged nearly 9 percent on Tuesday, making the stock one of the top smallcap gainers, after the air-cooler maker announced plans to enter adjacent consumer-durable categories including room air conditioners, BLDC ceiling fans and air purifiers.

The Symphony stock was trading 8.5 percent higher at Rs 622 in late-morning deals, even as the broader market remained under pressure. At 11:15 am, the Sensex was down 420 points, or 0.55 percent, at 75,712, while the Nifty 50 declined 0.44 percent to 23,674. The Nifty Smallcap 100 was marginally lower by 0.08 percent.
Despite Tuesday's sharp rally, Symphony shares remain down around 32 percent so far in 2026. The company has a market capitalisation of about Rs 4,300 crore.

The rally followed Symphony's announcement that it proposes a "calibrated and phased" expansion of its India product portfolio into room air conditioners, BLDC ceiling fans and air purifiers. The company said the move would broaden its addressable market through adjacent consumer-durable categories with long-term growth potential.

Symphony plans to leverage its existing capabilities in cooling, brand-building, distribution, consumer insights and after-sales service for the expansion. The strategy is also aligned with its focus on strengthening the Beyond India Summer Products portfolio while retaining its focus on the household air-cooler business.

Importantly, the expansion will follow an asset-light model, with Symphony currently having no plans to invest in its own manufacturing capacity. Instead, the company intends to progressively deploy internal accruals towards product development, inventory, brand-building, channel and service readiness, and working capital.

The new products are proposed to be introduced selectively across product ranges, markets and distribution channels beginning in the December 2026 quarter. Symphony said the pace and scale of the expansion would depend on consumer response, execution readiness and satisfactory commercial and operating outcomes.

title: Symphony shares surge 9% as company plans entry into ACs, BLDC fans and air purifiers
